senses.gloss: (denom. of preced.) זָ׳ זֶרֶד (= עשה חיל) to do valiantly.
[to strengthen, accelerate growth; cmp. בְּרָא Af.,] to trim, nip shoots off.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:2">Sabb. XII, 2</cite> <he>המקרסם והמְזָרֵד</he> he who cuts off dry twigs, or young shoots.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:10">Ab. Zar. III, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 49b">49ᵇ</cite>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:6">Tosef. Sabb. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:16">X</cite>), 16 <cite ref="F00026"><he>וזֵרֵד</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>וזירד</he>).
